newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing early-Sep wheat around $146.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing early-Sep wheat around $146.

text.p: A European Union award of 85,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a minimum tax of 0.10 Ecus per tonne values a tonne of early September French wheat at $146.42 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
+ EU increment (added to refunds only) 0.00 ecus/tonne
Implied fob price in dollars $146.42 dollars/tonne
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $146.60 per tonne. Sep U.S. soft red winter $139 per tonne.
